item.title: Boonslick Regional Library releases upcoming arrivals
item.description: If you’re looking for a way to beat the cold this winter, check out the latest and most popular arrivals at the Boonslick Regional Library.

item.title: HISTORICALLY YOURS
item.description: There are many important dates in the history of our nation. October 13, 1775, is one of them. It was on this day that the Continental Congress authorized the purchase and outfitting of two armed vessels to intercept British supply ships during the Revolutionary War.

item.title: Prairie Home Corn Hole tournament to benefit the Booster Club
item.description: The Prairie Home Booster Club presents the 2nd Annual Corn Hole Tournament on Saturday, February 21st at 11am in the school gym. Food and drinks will be available for purchase at the concession stand. No outside drinks or food please. Register before or day of tournament--$40/team. Prizes will be awarded to the winning teams!

item.title: Boonville R-1 School District names Ellen Tucker as Principal of Laura Speed Elliott Middle School
item.description: The Boonville R-1 School District is pleased to announce that the Board of Education approved the hiring of Ellen Tucker as the next Principal of Laura Speed Elliott Middle School (LSE) at its February 18 meeting. Her appointment will take effect for the 2026–2027 school year.
